svg.title: AMAI Launchpad · Mooncat token page
svg.desc: Mooncat token detail concept on the AMAI launchpad. Market activity, balances, comments, receipts, scores, quotes and progress are illustrative design fixtures, not live data. Original AMAI branding and original Mooncat vector artwork are preserved. A separate publication caption should describe the product preview.

g.text: The cat has left the group chat.
Trading fees become Stock Tokens for holders.
Trading continues in the pool after graduation.
Helmet on. Group chat off. Welcome to the crew.
A cat in a spacesuit paying me in NVDA. What a timeline.
The helmet stays on. Even in the comments.
The cat has left the group chat.
An orbital little menace with a soft spot
